arxiv-1908-04383.title: Apache Spark Accelerated Deep Learning Inference for Large Scale Satellite Image Analytics
arxiv-1908-04383.creator: Dalton Lunga, Jonathan Gerrand, Hsiuhan Lexie Yang, Christopher Layton and Robert Stewart
arxiv-1908-04383.description: Abstract The shear volumes of data generated from earth observation and remote sensing technologies continue to make major impact; leaping key geospatial applications into the dual data and compute intensive era. As a consequence, this rapid advancement poses new computational and data processing challenges.

arxiv-2211-09829.title: Constructing precisely quasi-isodynamic magnetic fields
arxiv-2211-09829.creator: Alan Goodman, Katia Camacho Mata, Sophia A Henneberg, Rogerio Jorge, Matt Landreman, Gabriel Plunk, Håkan Smith, Ralf Mackenbach, Per Helander
arxiv-2211-09829.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Alan Goodman, Katia Camacho Mata, Sophia A Henneberg, Rogerio Jorge, Matt Landreman, Gabriel Plunk, Håkan Smith, Ralf Mackenbach, Per Helander. We present a novel method for numerically finding quasi-isodynamic stellarator magnetic fields with excellent fast-particle confinement and extremely small neoclassical transport. The method works particularly well in configurations with only one field period.

arxiv-2211-12656.title: ActiveRMAP: Radiance Field for Active Mapping And Planning
arxiv-2211-12656.creator: Huangying Zhan, Jiyang Zheng, Yi Xu, Ian Reid, Hamid Rezatofighi
arxiv-2211-12656.description: Abstract A high-quality 3D reconstruction of a scene from a collection of 2D images can be achieved through offline/online mapping methods. In this paper, we explore active mapping from the perspective of implicit representations, which have recently produced compelling results in a variety of applications.

arxiv-2502-21279.title: L-Lipschitz Gershgorin ResNet Network
arxiv-2502-21279.creator: Marius F. R. Juston, William R. Norris, Dustin Nottage, Ahmet Soylemezoglu
arxiv-2502-21279.description: Abstract Deep residual networks (ResNets) have demonstrated outstanding success in computer vision tasks, attributed to their ability to maintain gradient flow through deep architectures. Simultaneously, controlling the Lipschitz bound in neural networks has emerged as an essential area of research for enhancing adversarial robustness and network certifiability.

arxiv-2601-19764.title: Schur’s theorem and its relation to the closure properties of the non-abelian tensor product
arxiv-2601-19764.creator: Guram Donadze, Manuel Ladra, Pilar Páez-Guillán
arxiv-2601-19764.description: Abstract . We show that the Schur multiplier of a Noetherian group need not be finitely generated. We prove that the non-abelian tensor product of a polycyclic (resp. polycyclic-by-finite) group and a Noetherian group, is a polycyclic (resp. polycyclic-by-finite) group. We also prove new versions of Schur’s theorem. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification 18G10, 18G50. 1.

pmc-10649333.description: The health status of emerging adults is at risk. pmc-11548455.title: Formulation of Thermo-Sensitive In Situ Gels Loaded with Dual Spectrum Antibiotics of Azithromycin and Ofloxacin
pmc-11548455.creator: Raghad Alsheikh, Ádám Haimhoffer, Dániel Nemes, Zoltán Ujhelyi, Pálma Fehér, Liza Józsa, Gábor Vasvári, Ágota Pető, Dóra Kósa, Lajos Nagy, László Horváth, Bence Balázs, Ildikó Bácskay
pmc-11548455.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). In situ gels have been developed as an innovative strategy to prolong corneal residence time and enhance drug absorption compared to traditional eye drops. Our study aimed to formulate an ophthalmic in situ gel with a combination of two thermosensitive poloxamers, P407 and P188, in an optimal ratio not only to increase the time of action but also to increase the solubility of selected antibiotics for the treatment of ophthalmic infections.

pmc-12652281.title: Rapid Surgeon-Led 3D Printing of Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Cylindrical Templates for Visceral Vessel Fenestration in Physician-Modified Endografts
pmc-12652281.creator: Juan Carlos Gomez-Rodriguez, Jesus Rosso, Barbara Dieck, Edison Peña, Andres Cadavid
pmc-12652281.description: Endovascular aortic aneurysm repair (EVAR) of complex abdominal aortic aneurysms (AAAs) requires precise preoperative planning to ensure proper alignment of visceral fenestrations. However, commercial planning platforms remain costly and often inaccessible for many vascular centers. Low-cost, surgeon-driven digital workflows utilizing open-source software and desktop three-dimensional (3D) printing have become practical alternatives, allowing patient-specific planning without dependence on proprietary systems.

pmc-13454288.title: Whole-genome sequencing uncovers diverse genetic causes and phenotypic signatures in infantile nystagmus and albinism
pmc-13454288.creator: Mahmoud R. Fassad, Pradeep C. Vasudevan, Julian Barwell, Gail DE Maconachie, Savita Madhusudhan, David Hunt, Irene Gottlob, Mariya Moosajee, Omar A. Mahroo, Andrew R. Webster, Michel Michaelides, Mervyn G. Thomas
pmc-13454288.description: We combined deep phenotype data and whole-genome sequencing results from the UK 100,000 Genomes Project (100KGP) to characterize the genetic spectrum of infantile nystagmus and albinism, and to explore genotype–phenotype correlations in this cohort. Participants were enrolled in the study based on the clinical codes for albinism or infantile nystagmus.
